gemma_responses.what_is_attention: Self-attention is a mechanism that allows each position in a sequence to attend to all positions in the same sequence. It computes a weighted sum of values, where the weights are determined by the compatibility of a query with corresponding keys. This allows the model to capture long-range dependencies efficiently.
